rationale: I independently recomputed the canonical candidate address as sha256:41a1e8b6dddc12da502db305e7044570f121784903e4183cf17a03a2ca100ef7 and confirmed the governed plan and evidence bytes match reviewed commit 915e12ff14203345ac8af1ae3b57624af705a2e0. The two-phase transition resolves DISCOVERY-001 coherently: Phase A preserves v15/authz-008 and registers only activation-deferred authority; Phase B atomically pivots authority with AM-43 canonicalization, governing-authority updates, same-PR re-weave, supersession, activation, and fail-closed verification. E1-E6, Phase-0/Phase-1a, release, installation, and atomic-weave contracts are internally consistent with the repository’s fail-closed, closed-set, content-addressed, immutable-evidence, and human-authority boundaries. I explicitly ratify SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM and product-1-oq-e6-determinism-deferral: the constrained declarative language is the settled sound design, normative-oracle enrollment remains blocked until its evaluator and concrete grammar pass the hard merge gate, and interim review/battery evidence is not overstated as semantic proof. I also ratify SPIKE-PD001-NOLISTENER-COMPLETENESS and product-1-oq-pd001-nolistener-completeness: the kernel-inherited, arch/x32-gated, filter-first static boot architecture is conceptually sound, while exhaustive residual-corner enumeration is acceptably deferred behind fail-closed qualification and eBPF/strace detection. The remaining recorded Eye-question dispositions are likewise accepted. This council approval authorizes the plan as written but remains distinct from the Eye’s required new S3 implementation-authority grant; CURRENT-AUTHORITY remains governed by authz-008 until Phase B.
